records.subject: Welcome aboard, Summit Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for setting up Summit Dynamics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

I know you've heard from us a couple of times already, so I'll keep this short. Nothing's needed from you yet on Summit Dynamics' side, and there's no open ticket to worry about.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the clearest starting point. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
